verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an in-product Canva AI that can take user content, such as pasted links from other platforms, as context for designing. Imported third-party data can also feed design generation. That is AI working on the user's data inside the product, but it produces designs rather than insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: any documented AI-generated insights or analysis of user data, any in-product AI suggestions or recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
